Text A. Jo and Sam know our guide; he is a friend of theirs. Our boat leaves at two and returns at three. A guide tells passengers about the river and the bridges. If you enjoy views from the water, this is a good choice. Keep your ticket with you for the return journey.

Text B. This short walk begins at eleven with a teacher. We follow a path beside the river and stop at an old bridge which was built in 1990. Bring comfortable shoes. If it rains heavily, the walk will not take place.

Text C. The museum opens at ten and is near the bus station. You can see an old engine, a scooter and several bicycles. Guides explain how travel has changed. This indoor visit can take place in any weather, and entry is free.
